input.combined_score: equal mean of the two repository cross-sectional z-scores

decay_test.metric: daily cross-sectional Spearman rank IC of the combined score
decay_test.development_selection: highest development mean IC; ties choose the shorter horizon
decay_test.qualification: selected horizon must have positive validation and test IC and a positive familywise combined validation-test bootstrap lower bound

portfolio.turnover: half L1 from drifted holdings including cash; no rebalance and zero turnover on hold weeks

fixed_candidates.monthly_equal_top5: replace the full top-five set only at the last weekly decision of each month; equal target weights
fixed_candidates.monthly_inverse_volatility_top5: replace the full top-five set only at the last weekly decision of each month; inverse-volatility targets capped at 30 percent
fixed_candidates.buffered_equal_top5: weekly review; maximum one replacement, incumbent minimum age four weeks, outsider score must exceed weakest replaceable incumbent by at least 0.5; rebalance only on membership change
fixed_candidates.buffered_inverse_volatility_top5: same membership buffer; inverse-volatility targets refreshed only on membership change or the last weekly decision of a month

promotion_gates.primary: 50-bps annual return positive, Sharpe at least 0.50, and maximum drawdown no worse than -35 percent
promotion_gates.controls: 50-bps candidate Sharpe exceeds stale, inverted, and permutation controls
promotion_gates.turnover_improvement: annual turnover below the corresponding Batch 31 weekly construction
promotion_gates.blend: 80/20 blend Sharpe exceeds core, drawdown no worse by more than two points, and familywise paired Sharpe lower bound positive
